text:
maya: Heads-up: we need a short handoff thread for the reliability metrics/dashboard work. Goal: unified error taxonomy + dashboards that surface timeouts, 5xx, OOMs, and degraded-mode/fallback counts across runtime + infra.

tony: +1. Which dimensions do we need? service/model/route/region/tier?

li: service, model, route, region, and a deployment_tier (hosted/dedicated/private) label would be ideal. Also include quantization/profile label where applicable.

sam: Agree. For dashboards we should show both rate (per-second) and error-rate (%) and a rolling SLO window. Also need a top-down panel: cluster-level, service-level, then route-level drilldown.

irina: UX ask: in Console, can we make a single canonical "Error Types" filter (Timeout / 5xx / OOM / Fallback) so PMs and SREs don't have to toggle labels manually?

sam: Yes — we can map labels to those buckets in Grafana/Console via a transform. We'll need a consistent label coming from runtime: error_class=timeout|server_5xx|oom|fallback|client_4xx.

maya: Action: runtime team to emit error_class and fallback_reason where applicable. infra to emit oom_count and kernel_oom boolean for host-level OOMs. Also add request_latency_ms histogram with percentiles.

tony: I'll send a PR to runtime metrics next sprint. Proposed metric names:

  - inference_requests_total{status_code=..., error_class=..., route=..., model=..., deployment_tier=...}
  - inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket{...}
  - inference_kv_cache_hits_total{...}
  - inference_fallbacks_total{fallback_reason=..., ...}

li: For infra/service-level OOMs we already have node_oom_events_total but we should export a per-deployment aggregation: deployment_ooms_total{deployment_id, service}

maya: Good. Two telemetry debates we need to resolve quickly:
  1) Should timeouts be a separate metric or just a status_code label on requests? (i.e. status_code=timeout)
  2) How to count degraded-mode responses where the request succeeded but used a smaller model or cached prefix? 

irina: Prefer status_code=timeout for easier rate math, but also keep error_class=timeout for human-friendly dashboards. For degraded-mode, emit a boolean label degraded=1 and a degradation_type label (e.g., model_fallback, cached_prefix, rate_limited).

sam: Example PromQL panels to validate:

  - 5xx rate: sum(rate(inference_requests_total{status_code=~"5.."}[5m])) by (service)
  - timeouts: sum(rate(inference_requests_total{error_class="timeout"}[5m]))
  - fallback count by reason: sum(rate(inference_fallbacks_total[10m])) by (fallback_reason)

qa-bot: Quick regression test suggestion: add an e2e that simulates OOM path so fallback_reason shows up and degraded=1 is recorded.

tony: Noted. Also need to add cardinality guardrails: don't allow arbitrary long label values for model/version — use model_family and model_id hashed or truncated.

li: We'll enforce label value length limit at the exporter layer and add a tag mapping table for model_family.

maya: Ownership: runtime (tony) adds labels/metrics; infra (li) adds deployment_ooms and node mappings; observability (sam) builds Grafana/Console panels and transformation; product/console (irina) designs filter UI; QA (qa-bot / manual) adds tests.

irina: For Console rollout UX: show a small "metric readiness" badge on route config that lists which of the four core metrics are available (timeouts, 5xx, OOM, fallback). That way customers know coverage before they rely on dashboards.

sam: We should version the telemetry contract in a repo file (e.g., telemetry/contract/v1) and document required/optional fields.

tony: I'll draft the telemetry contract PR and a short CLI check that validates metrics on a staging cluster.

li: Can we get infra to run a nightly check that verifies deployment_ooms_total is present for all dedicated/private clusters? If missing, alert oncall.

oncall-bot: reminder: add an alert template for missing core metrics by deployment. Template created: #alerts/core-metrics-missing

maya: Timeline: PRs for metrics in sprint+1, infra exporter changes in sprint+1, grafana panels + Console badge in sprint+2. Can everyone +1 the timeline?

tonys: +1 (typo: tony)

li: +1

sam: +1

irina: +1

maya: OK. I'll synthesize an ADO ticket with owners and acceptance criteria. Quick acceptance criteria draft:
  - error_class label emitted with one of the canonical values
  - fallback_reason and degraded label present when applicable
  - deployment_ooms_total exported for infra
  - Console shows metric readiness badge in feature flag for beta routes
  - Grafana panels importable and have drilldown links to Console route pages

maya: tagging folks for follow-up: @tony @li @sam @irina. I'll drop the ticket and link back here when created. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sam: thanks — I'll start the dashboard skeleton and post links here when ready.

qa-bot: test plan checklist added to the ticket template.

maya: closing thread — will reopen if requirements change.
